source: Offline validation of config/ecan_signals.json against the 2026-10-07 recording (GNSS/radar references) and the 2026-10-08 standstill capture; independent spot checks re-run from raw data for the steering sign, ObjValid, CRC8/CRC16 rules, brake inverse, front-axle state and trip distance.

remove.0x1A0.ACC_ObjRelSpd#003: Overlaps the object flag bit; #030 (35:9) is used.
remove.0x04A.IMU_VerAccelVal: Low byte of the 16-bit vertical acceleration; VERTICAL_ACCEL_16BIT_CANDIDATE kept.
remove.0x0A0.MOVING_FORWARD: Constant 0 while driving forward; not a direction flag on this vehicle.
remove.0x0A0.MOVING_FORWARD2: Constant 0 while driving forward; not a direction flag on this vehicle.
remove.0x1AA.CRUISE_BUTTONS: Constant out-of-enum 7 on both days; 0x1CF.CRUISE_BUTTONS is the button source.
remove.0x1AA.LFA_BTN: Stayed 0 during LFA presses seen on 0x1CF; not the LFA button here.

0x060.BRAKE_PRESSED.name: AVH_HOLD_INDICATION
0x060.BRAKE_PRESSED.label_ko: 정차 유지(오토홀드) 표시 후보, 운전자 페달 아님

add.name: FRONT_AXLE_CONNECTION_STATE_2BIT
add.meaning_en: Front-axle (front motor) connection state: 0 while the front motor is decoupled/stationary, 2 while connected and co-rotating; 1 and 3 only briefly during transitions.

add.name: DRIVE_DEMAND_SIGNED_RAW
add.meaning_en: Signed drive-demand-like quantity (bits 85..87 are sign extension of bit 84; 72:13 signed decodes identically). Tracks the sum of the front and rear drive-load copies and the accelerator pedal; negative values occur during coasting/regen.

add.name: FRONT_AXLE_DISCONNECTED_STATUS
add.meaning_en: Inverse copy of the front-axle connection flag (1 = front motor decoupled).

add.name: FRONT_AXLE_CONNECTION_LEAD_FLAG
add.meaning_en: AWD connection-related inverse flag that changes about 0.34..0.44 s before the front axle connects and 0.11..0.26 s after it disconnects (request-like timing; the request interpretation is inference).

add.name: BRAKE_PRESSED_INVERTED
add.meaning_en: Exact inverse of 0x065.BRAKE_PRESSED.

add.name: FRONT_REGEN_BRAKE_RAW
add.meaning_en: Front-motor regenerative braking amount (raw). Non-zero only while the brake pedal is pressed; follows the negative part of the front drive load.

add.name: TOTAL_BRAKE_DEMAND_RAW
add.meaning_en: Total brake demand (friction + regen) in a common raw unit: equals about 8.76 x friction pressure + 1.0 x rear regen + 0.8 x front regen.

add.name: BRAKE_PEDAL_TRAVEL_COARSE
add.meaning_en: Coarse brake pedal travel, about BRAKE_POSITION / 5 (2 at rest, 75 at maximum observed).

add.name: BRAKE_PEDAL_TRAVEL_COARSE_COPY
add.meaning_en: Bit-exact duplicate of 0x065 104:7.

add.name: REAR_REGEN_BRAKE_RAW
add.meaning_en: Rear-motor regenerative braking amount (raw). Non-zero only while braking; follows the negative part of the rear drive load; coefficient 1.0 in the total-brake fit.

add.name: AVH_HOLDING_COPY
add.meaning_en: Copy of 0x060.AVH_Sta == 1 (vehicle held by service brake).

add.name: CHECKSUM
add.meaning_en: Hyundai CAN-FD CRC16 (XMODEM table over bytes 2..N-1, then address bytes, then length XOR). Value 0xFFFF appears in a few frames as a non-CRC placeholder.
add.evidence: {"opendbc_algorithm_match_non_ffff": 1.0, "frames": 6572, "ffff_head_frames": 11, "ffff_true_crc_is_ffff": 0, "gf2_affine_test": {"rank_x": 20, "rank_xy": 20, "affine": true, "deterministic": true}, "note": "Prior 32768-polynomial search returned nothing because the 0xFFFF placeholder frames were included."}

add.name: FRONT_AXLE_CONNECTED
add.meaning_en: Front axle connected (front motor coupled). With 0, the front motor speed is near zero while the rear motor turns; with 1 both motors co-rotate. Connects when slowing below about 4 m/s or braking hard, disconnects when accelerating above about 6 m/s (AWD disconnector behaviour is inference).

add.meaning_en: Copy of 0x065 72:10 (front regen).

add.name: REAR_REGEN_BRAKE_RAW_COPY
add.meaning_en: Copy of 0x065 128:10 (rear regen).

add.name: FRONT_MOTOR_TORQUE_LIMIT_A
add.meaning_en: Speed-dependent front-motor limit: constant 122 below about 2260 rpm, then decreasing roughly as 1/rpm (constant-power region). Units unknown.

add.name: FRONT_MOTOR_TORQUE_LIMIT_B

add.name: CRC8_CHECKSUM
add.label_ko: CRC8 무결성 값 (다항식 0x1D, CAN ID 포함)
add.meaning_en: CRC8 poly 0x1D (SAE J1850), init 0xFF, xorout 0xEA (equivalently init 0x00, xorout 0x69) over [CAN ID low byte, CAN ID high byte, payload bytes 1..7]
add.evidence: Poly brute force (255 polys x reflect in/out) with per-ID residual over 16 multi-payload IDs gave a single hit, poly 0x1D. One global init/xorout pair with the CAN ID prefixed then matched all 49 distinct payloads of 24 IDs (2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08), i.e. every frame of these IDs.

add.name: CHANGE_COUNTER
add.meaning_en: 4-bit counter, modulo 15 (0..14, 15 not seen), increments once per payload content change, not per frame; a change is sent as a burst of about 4 frames at 40 ms, then 200 ms cyclic
add.evidence: counter 0 on both days; no content change observed

add.name: CHECKSUM
add.meaning_en: Hyundai CAN-FD checksum used by opendbc hkg_can_fd_checksum: CRC16 XMODEM (poly 0x1021, init 0) over bytes 2..7 then address low/high byte, xor 0x5F29 for 8-byte frames
add.evidence: 25 of 25 distinct non-0xFFFF payloads across the 8 IDs match. 24 frames (0.09 %, single isolated frames, never simultaneous across IDs, none on 2026-10-08) carry 0xFFFF in this field with unchanged data; meaning of 0xFFFF unresolved (an invalid/substitute marker is inference only).

add.name: CHANGE_SEQUENCE_COUNTER
add.meaning_en: 8-bit counter incremented once per content change; the first frame of a change still carries the old value, the following burst frames the incremented value
add.evidence: 0x0E -> 0x0F -> 0x10 -> 0x11 at the 3 content changes; 0x12 in capture 6 matches the one inferred change (bits 24..25 back to 2) in the capture gap; 0x01 on 2026-10-08
